x: In the 800 heats and semi's Seb Coe was looking tired and new boy Matthew Yates did what we had seen so many times in last year's British League matches - left it late and kicked with devastating effect over the last 140m to ease into the final.

I have this theory that Matthew Yates will do something special in the 1500 metres and others seem to agree with me. He has that arrogance and blazing speed and is an "unknown" - if only he can get up and stay near the front.
Another high-flyer in the TSB lists who has recently switched to the Bels. is Matthew Yates, already well known to some of our middle-distance men.

Matthew Yates ran an excellent 1500m and was just pipped on the line for 2nd while Darren Mead placed 6th with a good run in the 3000m and the sprint boys came through after a slow start to take 4th in the 4x100m relay.
